situation-room.choose-your-party: Choose the party this campaign stands for.
situation-room.org-check-note: Hawkeye checks that this room speaks for the organisation you choose before its invite links work — every organisation the same way.
situation-room.org-listing-note: Organisations are listed only so you can find yours. Being listed is not a partnership with Hawkeye or an endorsement by it.
situation-room.org-required: Choose your organisation, or type its name under Other.
situation-room.name-names-org: That name names an organisation ({v0}). Only a room verified for that organisation may use it — choose it when you set the room up, or pick another name.
situation-room.election-over: That election is over, so a new room cannot be set up for it.
situation-room.too-many-room-requests: You have asked Hawkeye to check several rooms today. Try again tomorrow.
situation-room.note-all-constituencies: Every state constituency in {v0}, counted together — for a party’s state-wide assembly room.
situation-room.note-seat-shares-lga: The register does not say which of this local government’s seats a polling unit votes in, so this room counts the whole local government.
situation-room.note-by-election-seat: This by-election is for one seat: {v0}.
situation-room.org-pending-banner: Hawkeye is checking that this room speaks for {v0} — every organisation is checked the same way. Until then invite links do not work and nobody new can join. You can set the room up meanwhile.
situation-room.org-block-banner: Hawkeye could not verify that this room speaks for the organisation it chose, so nobody new can join.
